profile.summary: Skillastics is a company that sells physical education and physical activity programs for after-school and PE settings. It offers activity kits with mats and lesson plans, plus online programs such as yoga and jump rope. Its customers are schools, after-school programs and community organizations serving children from early childhood through 8th grade.
